name: Myanmar
officialName: Republic of the Union of Myanmar

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, green and red, with a large white five-pointed star in the centre spanning all three.
flag.symbolism: Yellow represents solidarity, green peace and tranquillity, and red courage and decisiveness; the white star stands for the union of the country.

hook: Myanmar is yellow-green-red with a huge white star straddling all three stripes; Lithuania has the same order with no star, and Ghana has a black star.
trivia: The flag was introduced in 2010 along with the 2008 constitution.
The government moved the capital from Yangon to the purpose-built city of Naypyidaw in 2005–2006.
